1. Macro Summary
The current macro environment is characterized by a neutral monetary policy stance with stable rates and a positive yield curve spread. Inflation is rising, driven by headline CPI, while core CPI remains contained. Economic growth is showing an upward trend, supported by moderate labor conditions. Liquidity is easing, and credit conditions are favorable, indicating a risk-on environment.

2. Monetary Policy Assessment
The Federal Funds Rate is at 3.64%, with a stable rate trend. The 10-year Treasury yield is 4.47%, and the 2-year Treasury yield is 4.0%, resulting in a positive yield spread of 0.47%. The overall policy stance is classified as neutral.

3. Inflation & Growth Assessment
Headline CPI year-over-year is 3.95% and is on a rising trend. Core CPI year-over-year is 2.99%. GDP growth quarter-over-quarter is 0.49% and is also on a rising trend. The unemployment rate is 4.3%, with a moderate trend in the labor market.

4. Liquidity & Credit Conditions
The Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index (NFCI) is -0.524, indicating easing financial conditions. The corporate credit spread is 0.76, suggesting healthy credit markets. The liquidity regime is classified as easing, and the overall risk regime is currently "risk-on."

5. Yield Curve Interpretation
The 10-year/2-year Treasury yield spread is positive at 0.47%, which typically signals expectations of future economic growth and a healthy economic outlook.

6. Equity Risk Regime (Risk-On / Neutral / Risk-Off)
Risk-On

7. Confidence Score (1-10)
8
